source.note: All addresses below are original ELF VMAs, no live runtime evidence

message_constructor.arguments: r0=destination_id, r1=event_code, r2=payload_word_1, r3=payload_word_2, stack_arg_at_caller_sp0=payload_word_3, stack_arg_at_caller_sp4=extra_plausibly_handle (checked wrapper loads sp+0x28)
message_constructor.note: Caller-supplied extra at sp+4 is read at 0x91c6 and propagated to helper 0x9198; not treated as message word.

caller_fields.r2: 0x9e5a a600 global+0x24 getter result -> 0x9e66 mov r2,r0
caller_fields.r3: 0x9e64 ldr [r7,#0x28], fresh dynamically allocated receiver queue ID

main_id_advertisement.information_boundary: Constructs a registration-like ID announcement through fixed 0x94016a, but external recipient/handler/delivery and actual success unknown.

alternate_id_advertisement.trigger: 0x96c4..0x96cc conditional path checks imports then requests dynamic ID
constructed_message_words: freshly allocated dynamic ID if successful
alternate_id_advertisement.limit: This second message constructor is reachable only under the 0x9698 helper's input/environment gates, not proof of an observed message.

callback_fsm.setter: 0xac08 stores callback Thumb pointer in global+0x08 and state r0 in global+0
callback_fsm.late_event_reactivation: 0x9edc..0x9ef2 conditionally calls ac08(state=3,callback=0xa06d), then 0x9ef6 calls ad0c(state=2)

state5_handler.action: 0x936a..0x9386 calls dynamic_id release/free and ac08(state=1,callback=0x9265), then acf4

callback_fsm.main_loop: 0x9e94 a580 gets dynamic queue ID; 0x9e9a ac18 gets callback ptr; 0x9eaa receives via osal_rcv_msg_tmo; on status 0, 0x9eb2 BLX r5 callback then frees message; 0x9eca checks continuation and branches 0x9e94
callback_fsm.stage_handler: 0xa06c used only when pointer is a06d
callback_fsm.stage_event_processing_condition: A successful receive on dynamic ID AND callback currently a06d AND recognized stage ID; presence of combined CLI tokens does not alone satisfy.
callback_fsm.state3_activation_guard: Main 0x9cb0 send via wrapper to non-0x94016a destination, success branch 0x9cb6→0x9edc; actual successful call unknown.

cross_phase_correction: Phase4.46 proved fixed ID 0x94016a differs from dynamic receive ID. Phase4.52 proves im explicitly publishes that dynamically allocated ID as message word2 under event 0x94001a to fixed ID 0x94016a; so an external actor could learn return-address information. No handler/forwarder is yet shown, and these facts cannot be promoted to successful event delivery.
